heading: ## Scope
replacement: Make the visible `<details>` block in Plan Estimation Forecast comments the sole stored copy of comparable-issue entries. Keep the logical forecast payload and downstream consumer interface unchanged by encoding the hidden record's `comparableIssues` field as a compact external-list descriptor and reconstructing the array during comment parsing. The descriptor must identify `<ul id="comparableIssues">`, record its count, and carry a SHA-256 fingerprint over the canonical comparable array. New writers use this encoding by default; readers accept both the new encoding and historical v1/v2 comments with embedded arrays. Any missing, duplicated, malformed, count-mismatched, or fingerprint-mismatched external list fails closed.
